gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically confirmed malignant glioma of the brain, Grade 4 (GBM)

candidate_evidence.quote: [RADIATION] Reduced margin adaptive radiotherapy: Reduced (5 mm) clinical target volume margin with weekly contrast-enhanced adaptive radiation on the MR-Linac treatment machine

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma (GBM) is a high grade glioma (brain tumor) that is treated with surgery or biopsy followed by radiotherapy (RT) given daily over 3 or 6 weeks with or without an oral chemotherapy.

coder_notes: Phase NA single-arm radiotherapy technique trial (MR-Linac adaptive RT); only registered intervention is radiation. Temozolomide is optional ('with or without chemotherapy (temozolamide)'), not given to every patient and not a registered intervention, so not listed; gadolinium contrast for adaptive MRI is not a registered intervention, so not listed. Treatment setting inferred as newly diagnosed from primary RT after surgery/biopsy and exclusion of prior cranial irradiation.
